what.zh: LMDeploy 只能通过 --api-keys 启动参数接收密钥；平台会在命令、日志和界面中把它替换为 <redacted>。
what.en: LMDeploy takes the key only as the --api-keys launch flag; the platform replaces it with <redacted> in commands, logs and the console.

label.zh: KV 缓存比例（权重之外的空闲显存）
label.en: KV cache fraction (of memory left after weights)

summary.zh: LMDeploy 把加载权重后剩余显存的这个比例分给 KV 缓存。
summary.en: LMDeploy gives this fraction of the memory left after the weights to the KV cache.

what.zh: 对应 --cache-max-entry-count。它是权重加载后空闲显存的比例，不是整卡比例。
what.en: Maps to --cache-max-entry-count. It is a fraction of the memory free after the weights load, not of the whole GPU.

whenToChange.zh: 启动时报显存不足就调小；同卡还有其它程序时也应调小。
whenToChange.en: Lower it when the start runs out of memory, or when other programs share the GPU.

tradeoffs.zh: 过高会让激活和 CUDA Graph 没有余量；过低则可同时处理的上下文变短。
tradeoffs.en: Too high leaves no room for activations and CUDA graphs; too low shortens the context that fits at once.

summary.zh: LMDeploy 的推理后端：TurboMind 或 PyTorch。
summary.en: LMDeploy's inference backend: TurboMind or PyTorch.

what.zh: 对应 --backend。留空时 LMDeploy 按模型自动选择，通常是 TurboMind。
what.en: Maps to --backend. Empty lets LMDeploy choose for the model, usually TurboMind.

whenToChange.zh: TurboMind 不支持某个模型，或需要 LoRA 适配器（仅 PyTorch 后端）时。
whenToChange.en: When TurboMind does not support a model, or when LoRA adapters are needed (PyTorch backend only).

tradeoffs.zh: 两个后端支持的模型、量化和功能不同，速度也不同。
tradeoffs.en: The backends differ in supported models, quantization and features, and in speed.

summary.zh: 启动时加载的 LoRA 适配器，每个有名字和目录，最多 8 个。
summary.en: LoRA adapters loaded at launch, each with a name and a folder, up to 8.

what.zh: 对应 --adapters 名字=路径。仅 PyTorch 后端支持；路径必须在平台的模型存储目录下。
what.en: Maps to --adapters name=path. Supported by the PyTorch backend only; paths must be under the platform's model storage roots.

whenToChange.zh: 同一个基础模型要服务多个微调版本时。
whenToChange.en: When one base model must serve several fine-tuned variants.

tradeoffs.zh: 适配器占用额外显存；LMDeploy 的 TurboMind 后端会忽略或拒绝它们。
tradeoffs.en: Adapters use extra VRAM; the TurboMind backend ignores or rejects them.
